title: Reaction
description: What the specification editor makes of a PM's plain-language reaction to the prototype: at most one proposed change to the accepted record, its reason, and a note for the PM. The editor names criteria and requirements by join id; the runner builds the pointer, assigns any new criterion's id, and mints the change as a proposal the PM approves or rejects.

change.description: The one change the reaction asks of the accepted record, or null when it is about presentation rather than product meaning. Name exactly one of `criterion` (to reword that criterion) or `requirement` (to add a criterion to it).

criterion.description: The criterion to reword, as REQ-n/AC-m.

requirement.description: The requirement to add a criterion to, as REQ-n.

statement.description: The criterion as it should read: provable by one piece of work, in one place.

rationale.description: Why the change follows from what the PM said. Empty only when change is null.

note.description: For the PM: what you understood, and anything to look at before deciding.
